name: entra-mcp
description: Verified AI & tech jobs straight from company ATSs — search, fit-score matching, salary stats and apply links. Employers (API key): post jobs, manage listings, search candidates.
long_description:
**ENTRA Jobs** connects Claude to [ENTRA](https://entracareers.com), the agent-ready job platform. Jobs are ingested directly from employer hiring systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and others), so every listing is live and verified — no scraped or ghost jobs.

**For candidates (no account needed):** search thousands of AI & tech roles at OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, SpaceX and 300+ other companies; filter by location, country, remote, salary and experience; match a resume or skill list to the best-fitting roles with an explainable fit score; check salary bands where employers publish them; see which companies are hiring for a role; get a direct apply link with a checklist. ENTRA finds and ranks — the human applies. Nothing is auto-submitted.

**For employers (optional API key):** post and manage jobs, read applications, search and match published candidate profiles for your company. Create a key at https://entracareers.com/employer/profile?tab=api-keys and paste it into the extension settings.

**Privacy:** the server runs locally and sends only your tool inputs to the ENTRA API. No telemetry, no third-party services. Policy: https://entracareers.com/privacy-policy

**Example prompts**
- "Find remote ML engineer jobs paying $200K+, posted this week."
- "Here is my resume — match it to the best-fitting roles and explain why."
- "Which companies are hiring LLM engineers right now?"
- Employer: "Post a job for a Senior ML Engineer in Dubai" (needs an ENTRA API key from your employer profile).

**Hosted endpoint:** the same tools are also served at https://mcp.entracareers.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP) for ChatGPT, claude.ai and Cursor remote connectors — this extension is the local, no-network-config option.

**How it works**: tools call the public ENTRA API (https://entracareers.com/api); no scraping, no telemetry. Finds and ranks — you apply.

entra_api_key.title: ENTRA employer API key (optional)
entra_api_key.description: Only for employers. Leave blank for job search. Create a key (entra_live_…) at https://entracareers.com/employer/profile?tab=api-keys to unlock post_job, my_jobs, update_job, close_job, job_applications, search_candidates and match_candidates.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search verified AI & tech jobs with filters (work location, country, company, salary, experience, recency); rank by date, salary or fit

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job: description, requirements, skills, salary band, company, apply link

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Companies hiring on ENTRA with open-role counts and profile links

tools.name: match_jobs
tools.description: Resume text or skills → ranked roles with an explainable fit score, matched skills and skill gaps

tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: Salary statistics for a role from listings that publish a band: min / p25 / median / p75 / max per currency

tools.name: companies_hiring
tools.description: Which companies are hiring for a role right now, with open-role counts and sample titles

tools.name: prepare_application
tools.description: Direct apply link plus a short checklist — the human reviews and applies, nothing is auto-submitted

tools.name: employer_whoami
tools.description: Employer mode: identify the API key — company, scopes and usable employer tools

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Employer mode: publish a job for your company (title, description, location, salary band, skills…)

tools.name: my_jobs
tools.description: Employer mode: list your company's jobs (active / closed / all) with application counts and manage URLs

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Employer mode: update fields of one of your jobs (only the fields you pass are changed)

tools.name: close_job
tools.description: Employer mode: close (unpublish) one of your jobs — preview first, requires confirm:true

tools.name: job_applications
tools.description: Employer mode: applications to your jobs with candidate details exactly as ENTRA returns them

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Employer mode: search published candidate profiles on ENTRA by query, skills, location, experience

tools.name: match_candidates
tools.description: Employer mode: rank candidates for one of your jobs with an explainable fit score

prompts.name: find_remote_ml_jobs
prompts.description: Find remote machine learning roles above a salary floor
prompts.text: Find remote machine learning engineer jobs paying at least $200,000 per year, posted in the last 14 days, ranked by salary.

prompts.name: match_my_resume
prompts.description: Match a pasted resume to the best-fitting verified roles
prompts.text: Here is my resume: <paste>. Match it to the 20 best-fitting jobs on ENTRA, explain why each fits, and list my skill gaps.

prompts.name: salary_check
prompts.description: Salary bands for a role from listed job postings
prompts.text: What do listed salary bands look like for senior data scientists in the United States right now, and which companies are hiring most?

prompts.name: employer_post_job
prompts.description: Employer mode: publish a job with the API key
prompts.text: Post a job: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Dubai, hybrid, full-time, $180K–$220K per year, 30 days. Then show my open jobs.
